description: This file is a PHP source script for the DetailView of EmailTemplates in the SuiteCRM project. It handles displaying the details of an email template, including rendering the template data, handling user interactions like edit, duplicate, delete, and managing related notes attachments.

classes.name: DetailView
classes.description: Class responsible for processing and rendering the detailed view of a module in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: Notes
classes.description: Bean class representing Notes, used to retrieve notes attached to the email template.

methods.name: processSugarBean
methods.description: Processes the request to load a Bean (record) based on the given module and record ID.

methods.name: get_full_list
methods.description: Retrieves a full list of Notes related to the EmailTemplate.
